title: Replace the wildcard `case _:` on the sealed AsyncValue switch in gamification_screen_l1_test.dart
why: AsyncValue is `sealed class AsyncValue<T>` with exactly 3 subtypes (AsyncData/AsyncLoading/AsyncError, verified in the riverpod package source). This switch handles AsyncData and AsyncError explicitly but falls back to a `case _:` wildcard for AsyncLoading instead of naming it. Per docs/coding-standards.md:197-199 (EH-6), a wildcard arm 'silently absorbs future variants and destroys' the compiler's exhaustiveness guarantee — here it also hides that the loading case is deliberately made to hang (Completer().future never completes) rather than being an oversight.
recommendation: Change `case _:` to `case AsyncLoading():` so the switch is explicitly exhaustive.
acceptance_criteria: The switch in _buildApp's achievementsOverviewProvider override names AsyncLoading() explicitly instead of using a wildcard arm.
